data.name: Fredrick
data.long_meaning: Fredrick is an English name derived from Old English frēod and ric, meaning 'peaceful ruler'. In Old English literature, Fredrick was used as a name for both men and women. In the Christian tradition, it is associated with the virtue of peace.
